what: Several slanted bars above the wordmark are drawn at .15s intervals (the first bar too, after .15s). Each ink band pushes in from the left end and is drawn over 1.6s cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1). Every 9 seconds, at the same interval, the bands push out through the right end, and 2.5 seconds later they are drawn again from the left. The curve’s ends are very flat, so each bar hesitates and then sweeps across all at once. Bar length and slant vary, so it feels like comb teeth switching on one by one

options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Bars (children, several) — position, width, height, rotate and transform-origin are set by the consuming css (it needs position: absolute or relative so the ink band fills inside the bar). Order follows document order
options.dur: Stroke in and out duration (s), default 1.6
options.each: Gap between bars (seconds), default .15 — the first bar is delayed by this much too
options.every: Beat where it starts to fade (s), default 9
options.gap: Time from start of fading out to start of being redrawn (sec), default 2.5

note: Like the original, CSS keyframes are swapped in by class (is-start · is-end) — the next stroke is not queued while the bar is still retreating. With reduced motion the bar stays drawn and stops.

from.where: index.html .ur-logo__bar — original .home-logo .js-logo-shape five (::before is shape-start · shape-end 1.6s cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1), 150ms apart, setInterval 9000 · within that, drawn again after 2500ms)
